# Generated by tools/generate_doctrine_switch.py.

# Use integer variables only. Assemble decimal digits as text because script
# arithmetic has less precision and range than doctrine mastery.
tfr_probe_infantry_mastery = {
    meta_effect = {
        text = {
            if = {
                limit = { has_mastery = { track = infantry amount = [AMOUNT] } }
                set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_probe_pass = 1 }
            }
            else = { set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_probe_pass = 0 } }
        }
        AMOUNT = "[?tfr_doctrine_probe|.0].[?tfr_doctrine_d1|.0][?tfr_doctrine_d2|.0][?tfr_doctrine_d3|.0][?tfr_doctrine_d4|.0][?tfr_doctrine_d5|.0]"
    }
}

tfr_save_infantry_mastery = {
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_d1 = 0 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_d2 = 0 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_d3 = 0 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_d4 = 0 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_d5 = 0 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_low = 0 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_high = 1024 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_probe = 1024 }
    tfr_probe_infantry_mastery = yes
    while_loop_effect = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_doctrine_probe_pass = 1 } }
        multiply_variable = { tfr_doctrine_high = 2 }
        multiply_variable = { tfr_doctrine_probe = 2 }
        tfr_probe_infantry_mastery = yes
    }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = tfr_doctrine_high }
    while_loop_effect = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap > 1 } }
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = tfr_doctrine_low }
        add_to_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = tfr_doctrine_high }
        divide_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = 2 }
        round_variable = tfr_doctrine_mid
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_probe = tfr_doctrine_mid }
        tfr_probe_infantry_mastery = yes
        if = {
            limit = { check_variable = { tfr_doctrine_probe_pass = 1 } }
            set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_low = tfr_doctrine_mid }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_high = tfr_doctrine_mid } }
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = tfr_doctrine_high }
        subtract_from_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = tfr_doctrine_low }
    }
    set_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_infantry_whole = tfr_doctrine_low }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_probe = tfr_doctrine_low }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_low = 0 }

    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = 10 }

tfr_restore_infantry_mastery = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                check_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_infantry_whole > 0 }
                check_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_infantry_d1 > 0 }
                check_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_infantry_d2 > 0 }
                check_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_infantry_d3 > 0 }
                check_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_infantry_d4 > 0 }
                check_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_infantry_d5 > 0 }
            }
        }
        meta_effect = {
            text = {
                add_mastery = { folder = land track = infantry amount = [AMOUNT] }
            }
            AMOUNT = "[?tfr_saved_mastery_infantry_whole|.0].[?tfr_saved_mastery_infantry_d1|.0][?tfr_saved_mastery_infantry_d2|.0][?tfr_saved_mastery_infantry_d3|.0][?tfr_saved_mastery_infantry_d4|.0][?tfr_saved_mastery_infantry_d5|.0]"
        }
    }
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_mastery_infantry_whole
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_mastery_infantry_d1
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_mastery_infantry_d2
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_mastery_infantry_d3
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_mastery_infantry_d4
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_mastery_infantry_d5
}

tfr_restore_combat_support_mastery = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                check_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_combat_support_whole > 0 }
                check_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_combat_support_d1 > 0 }
                check_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_combat_support_d2 > 0 }
                check_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_combat_support_d3 > 0 }
                check_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_combat_support_d4 > 0 }
                check_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_combat_support_d5 > 0 }
            }
        }
        meta_effect = {
            text = {
                add_mastery = { folder = land track = combat_support amount = [AMOUNT] }
            }
            AMOUNT = "[?tfr_saved_mastery_combat_support_whole|.0].[?tfr_saved_mastery_combat_support_d1|.0][?tfr_saved_mastery_combat_support_d2|.0][?tfr_saved_mastery_combat_support_d3|.0][?tfr_saved_mastery_combat_support_d4|.0][?tfr_saved_mastery_combat_support_d5|.0]"
        }
    }
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_mastery_combat_support_whole
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_mastery_combat_support_d1
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_mastery_combat_support_d2
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_mastery_combat_support_d3
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_mastery_combat_support_d4
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_mastery_combat_support_d5
}

    while_loop_effect = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap > 1 } }
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = tfr_doctrine_low }
        add_to_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = tfr_doctrine_high }
        divide_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = 2 }
        round_variable = tfr_doctrine_mid
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_d2 = tfr_doctrine_mid }
        tfr_probe_armor_mastery = yes
        if = {
            limit = { check_variable = { tfr_doctrine_probe_pass = 1 } }
            set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_low = tfr_doctrine_mid }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_high = tfr_doctrine_mid } }
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = tfr_doctrine_high }
        subtract_from_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = tfr_doctrine_low }
    }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_d2 = tfr_doctrine_low }
    set_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_armor_d2 = tfr_doctrine_low }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_low = 0 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_high = 10 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = 10 }
    while_loop_effect = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap > 1 } }
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = tfr_doctrine_low }
        add_to_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = tfr_doctrine_high }
        divide_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = 2 }
        round_variable = tfr_doctrine_mid
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_d3 = tfr_doctrine_mid }
        tfr_probe_armor_mastery = yes
        if = {
            limit = { check_variable = { tfr_doctrine_probe_pass = 1 } }
            set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_low = tfr_doctrine_mid }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_high = tfr_doctrine_mid } }
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = tfr_doctrine_high }
        subtract_from_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = tfr_doctrine_low }
    }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_d3 = tfr_doctrine_low }
    set_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_armor_d3 = tfr_doctrine_low }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_low = 0 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_high = 10 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = 10 }
    while_loop_effect = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap > 1 } }
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = tfr_doctrine_low }
        add_to_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = tfr_doctrine_high }
        divide_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = 2 }
        round_variable = tfr_doctrine_mid
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_d4 = tfr_doctrine_mid }
        tfr_probe_armor_mastery = yes
        if = {
            limit = { check_variable = { tfr_doctrine_probe_pass = 1 } }
            set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_low = tfr_doctrine_mid }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_high = tfr_doctrine_mid } }
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = tfr_doctrine_high }
        subtract_from_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = tfr_doctrine_low }
    }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_d4 = tfr_doctrine_low }
    set_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_armor_d4 = tfr_doctrine_low }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_low = 0 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_high = 10 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = 10 }
    while_loop_effect = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap > 1 } }
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = tfr_doctrine_low }
        add_to_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = tfr_doctrine_high }
        divide_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = 2 }
        round_variable = tfr_doctrine_mid
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_d5 = tfr_doctrine_mid }
        tfr_probe_armor_mastery = yes
        if = {
            limit = { check_variable = { tfr_doctrine_probe_pass = 1 } }
            set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_low = tfr_doctrine_mid }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_high = tfr_doctrine_mid } }
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = tfr_doctrine_high }
        subtract_from_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = tfr_doctrine_low }
    }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_d5 = tfr_doctrine_low }
    set_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_armor_d5 = tfr_doctrine_low }
}

tfr_restore_armor_mastery = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                check_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_armor_whole > 0 }
                check_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_armor_d1 > 0 }
                check_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_armor_d2 > 0 }
                check_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_armor_d3 > 0 }
                check_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_armor_d4 > 0 }
                check_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_armor_d5 > 0 }
            }
        }
        meta_effect = {
            text = {
                add_mastery = { folder = land track = armor amount = [AMOUNT] }
            }
            AMOUNT = "[?tfr_saved_mastery_armor_whole|.0].[?tfr_saved_mastery_armor_d1|.0][?tfr_saved_mastery_armor_d2|.0][?tfr_saved_mastery_armor_d3|.0][?tfr_saved_mastery_armor_d4|.0][?tfr_saved_mastery_armor_d5|.0]"
        }
    }
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_mastery_armor_whole
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_mastery_armor_d1
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_mastery_armor_d2
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_mastery_armor_d3
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_mastery_armor_d4
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_mastery_armor_d5
}

# Use integer variables only. Assemble decimal digits as text because script
# arithmetic has less precision and range than doctrine mastery.
tfr_probe_operations_mastery = {
    meta_effect = {
        text = {
            if = {
                limit = { has_mastery = { track = operations amount = [AMOUNT] } }
                set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_probe_pass = 1 }
            }
            else = { set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_probe_pass = 0 } }
        }
        AMOUNT = "[?tfr_doctrine_probe|.0].[?tfr_doctrine_d1|.0][?tfr_doctrine_d2|.0][?tfr_doctrine_d3|.0][?tfr_doctrine_d4|.0][?tfr_doctrine_d5|.0]"
    }
}

tfr_save_operations_mastery = {
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_d1 = 0 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_d2 = 0 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_d3 = 0 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_d4 = 0 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_d5 = 0 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_low = 0 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_high = 1024 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_probe = 1024 }
    tfr_probe_operations_mastery = yes
    while_loop_effect = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_doctrine_probe_pass = 1 } }
        multiply_variable = { tfr_doctrine_high = 2 }
        multiply_variable = { tfr_doctrine_probe = 2 }
        tfr_probe_operations_mastery = yes
    }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = tfr_doctrine_high }
    while_loop_effect = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap > 1 } }
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = tfr_doctrine_low }
        add_to_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = tfr_doctrine_high }
        divide_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = 2 }
        round_variable = tfr_doctrine_mid
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_probe = tfr_doctrine_mid }
        tfr_probe_operations_mastery = yes
        if = {
            limit = { check_variable = { tfr_doctrine_probe_pass = 1 } }
            set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_low = tfr_doctrine_mid }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_high = tfr_doctrine_mid } }
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = tfr_doctrine_high }
        subtract_from_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = tfr_doctrine_low }
    }
    set_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_operations_whole = tfr_doctrine_low }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_probe = tfr_doctrine_low }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_low = 0 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_high = 10 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = 10 }
    while_loop_effect = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap > 1 } }
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = tfr_doctrine_low }
        add_to_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = tfr_doctrine_high }
        divide_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = 2 }
        round_variable = tfr_doctrine_mid
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_d1 = tfr_doctrine_mid }
        tfr_probe_operations_mastery = yes

            set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_low = tfr_doctrine_mid }

    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_low = 0 }

        add_to_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = tfr_doctrine_high }
        divide_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = 2 }
        round_variable = tfr_doctrine_mid
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_d2 = tfr_doctrine_mid }
        tfr_probe_operations_mastery = yes
        if = {
            limit = { check_variable = { tfr_doctrine_probe_pass = 1 } }
            set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_low = tfr_doctrine_mid }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_high = tfr_doctrine_mid } }
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = tfr_doctrine_high }
        subtract_from_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = tfr_doctrine_low }

tfr_restore_operations_mastery = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                check_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_operations_whole > 0 }
                check_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_operations_d1 > 0 }
                check_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_operations_d2 > 0 }
                check_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_operations_d3 > 0 }
                check_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_operations_d4 > 0 }
                check_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_operations_d5 > 0 }
            }
        }
        meta_effect = {
            text = {
                add_mastery = { folder = land track = operations amount = [AMOUNT] }
            }
            AMOUNT = "[?tfr_saved_mastery_operations_whole|.0].[?tfr_saved_mastery_operations_d1|.0][?tfr_saved_mastery_operations_d2|.0][?tfr_saved_mastery_operations_d3|.0][?tfr_saved_mastery_operations_d4|.0][?tfr_saved_mastery_operations_d5|.0]"
        }
    }
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_mastery_operations_whole
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_mastery_operations_d1
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_mastery_operations_d2
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_mastery_operations_d3
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_mastery_operations_d4
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_mastery_operations_d5
}

tfr_save_land_doctrines = {
    set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_infantry = 0 }
    if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = mobile_infantry }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_infantry = 1 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = defensive_postures }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_infantry = 2 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = large_unit_tactics }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_infantry = 3 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = assault_infantry }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_infantry = 4 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = mounted_infantry }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_infantry = 5 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = commandos }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_infantry = 6 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = irregulars }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_infantry = 7 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = peoples_war }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_infantry = 8 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = great_war_infantry }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_infantry = 9 }
    }
    tfr_save_infantry_mastery = yes
    set_variable = { tfr_saved_counter_exists_infantry = 0 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = infantry_milestone_var }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_counter_exists_infantry = 1 }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_counter_infantry = infantry_milestone_var }
    }
    set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_combat_support = 0 }
    if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = fire_concentration }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_combat_support = 1 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = anti_tank_frontline }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_combat_support = 2 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = flying_batteries }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_combat_support = 3 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = air_cavalry }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_combat_support = 4 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = mobile_recon_and_assault }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_combat_support = 5 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = mobile_recon_and_assault_no_lar }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_combat_support = 6 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = self_propelled_support }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_combat_support = 7 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = siege_artillery }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_combat_support = 8 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = field_engineering }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_combat_support = 9 }
    }
    tfr_save_combat_support_mastery = yes
    set_variable = { tfr_saved_counter_exists_combat_support = 0 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = support_milestone_var }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_counter_exists_combat_support = 1 }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_counter_combat_support = support_milestone_var }
    }
    set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_armor = 0 }
    if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = armored_spearhead }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_armor = 1 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = armored_spearhead_no_lar }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_armor = 2 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = armored_infantry_support }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_armor = 3 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = streamlined_deployment }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_armor = 4 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = mobile_defense }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_armor = 5 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = armored_cavalry }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_armor = 6 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = armored_cavalry_no_lar }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_armor = 7 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = tank_destroyer_force }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_armor = 8 }
    }
    tfr_save_armor_mastery = yes
    set_variable = { tfr_saved_counter_exists_armor = 0 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = armor_milestone_var }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_counter_exists_armor = 1 }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_counter_armor = armor_milestone_var }
    }
    set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_operations = 0 }
    if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = mission_type_tactics }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_operations = 1 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = last_stand }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_operations = 2 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = infiltration_tactics }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_operations = 3 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = grand_assault }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_operations = 4 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = deep_battle }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_operations = 5 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = guerilla_war }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_operations = 6 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = rapid_domination }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_operations = 7 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = expeditionary_warfare }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_operations = 8 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = dispersed_operations }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_operations = 9 }
    }
    tfr_save_operations_mastery = yes
    set_variable = { tfr_saved_counter_exists_operations = 0 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = operations_milestone_var }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_counter_exists_operations = 1 }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_counter_operations = operations_milestone_var }
    }
}

tfr_restore_land_doctrines = {
    if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_infantry = 1 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = mobile_infantry folder = land track = 0 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_infantry = 2 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = defensive_postures folder = land track = 0 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_infantry = 3 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = large_unit_tactics folder = land track = 0 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_infantry = 4 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = assault_infantry folder = land track = 0 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_infantry = 5 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = mounted_infantry folder = land track = 0 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_infantry = 6 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = commandos folder = land track = 0 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_infantry = 7 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = irregulars folder = land track = 0 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_infantry = 8 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = peoples_war folder = land track = 0 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_infantry = 9 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = great_war_infantry folder = land track = 0 }
    }
    tfr_restore_infantry_mastery = yes
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_sub_infantry
    if = { limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_counter_exists_infantry = 1 } }
        set_variable = { infantry_milestone_var = tfr_saved_counter_infantry }
    }
    else = { clear_variable = infantry_milestone_var }
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_counter_infantry
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_counter_exists_infantry
    if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_combat_support = 1 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = fire_concentration folder = land track = 1 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_combat_support = 2 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = anti_tank_frontline folder = land track = 1 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_combat_support = 3 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = flying_batteries folder = land track = 1 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_combat_support = 4 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = air_cavalry folder = land track = 1 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_combat_support = 5 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = mobile_recon_and_assault folder = land track = 1 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_combat_support = 6 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = mobile_recon_and_assault_no_lar folder = land track = 1 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_combat_support = 7 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = self_propelled_support folder = land track = 1 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_combat_support = 8 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = siege_artillery folder = land track = 1 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_combat_support = 9 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = field_engineering folder = land track = 1 }
    }
    tfr_restore_combat_support_mastery = yes
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_sub_combat_support
    if = { limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_counter_exists_combat_support = 1 } }
        set_variable = { support_milestone_var = tfr_saved_counter_combat_support }
    }
    else = { clear_variable = support_milestone_var }
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_counter_combat_support
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_counter_exists_combat_support
    if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_armor = 1 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = armored_spearhead folder = land track = 2 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_armor = 2 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = armored_spearhead_no_lar folder = land track = 2 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_armor = 3 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = armored_infantry_support folder = land track = 2 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_armor = 4 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = streamlined_deployment folder = land track = 2 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_armor = 5 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = mobile_defense folder = land track = 2 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_armor = 6 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = armored_cavalry folder = land track = 2 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_armor = 7 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = armored_cavalry_no_lar folder = land track = 2 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_armor = 8 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = tank_destroyer_force folder = land track = 2 }
    }
    tfr_restore_armor_mastery = yes
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_sub_armor
    if = { limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_counter_exists_armor = 1 } }
        set_variable = { armor_milestone_var = tfr_saved_counter_armor }
    }
    else = { clear_variable = armor_milestone_var }
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_counter_armor
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_counter_exists_armor
    if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_operations = 1 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = mission_type_tactics folder = land track = 3 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_operations = 2 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = last_stand folder = land track = 3 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_operations = 3 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = infiltration_tactics folder = land track = 3 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_operations = 4 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = grand_assault folder = land track = 3 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_operations = 5 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = deep_battle folder = land track = 3 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_operations = 6 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = guerilla_war folder = land track = 3 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_operations = 7 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = rapid_domination folder = land track = 3 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_operations = 8 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = expeditionary_warfare folder = land track = 3 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_operations = 9 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = dispersed_operations folder = land track = 3 }
    }
    tfr_restore_operations_mastery = yes
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_sub_operations
    if = { limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_counter_exists_operations = 1 } }
        set_variable = { operations_milestone_var = tfr_saved_counter_operations }
    }
    else = { clear_variable = operations_milestone_var }
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_counter_operations
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_counter_exists_operations
    tfr_clear_doctrine_snapshot = yes
}

# Use integer variables only. Assemble decimal digits as text because script
# arithmetic has less precision and range than doctrine mastery.
tfr_probe_submarines_mastery = {
    meta_effect = {
        text = {
            if = {
                limit = { has_mastery = { track = submarines amount = [AMOUNT] } }
                set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_probe_pass = 1 }
            }
            else = { set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_probe_pass = 0 } }
        }
        AMOUNT = "[?tfr_doctrine_probe|.0].[?tfr_doctrine_d1|.0][?tfr_doctrine_d2|.0][?tfr_doctrine_d3|.0][?tfr_doctrine_d4|.0][?tfr_doctrine_d5|.0]"
    }
}

tfr_save_submarines_mastery = {
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_d1 = 0 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_d2 = 0 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_d3 = 0 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_d4 = 0 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_d5 = 0 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_low = 0 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_high = 1024 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_probe = 1024 }
    tfr_probe_submarines_mastery = yes
    while_loop_effect = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_doctrine_probe_pass = 1 } }
        multiply_variable = { tfr_doctrine_high = 2 }
        multiply_variable = { tfr_doctrine_probe = 2 }
        tfr_probe_submarines_mastery = yes
    }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = tfr_doctrine_high }
    while_loop_effect = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap > 1 } }
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = tfr_doctrine_low }
        add_to_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = tfr_doctrine_high }
        divide_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = 2 }
        round_variable = tfr_doctrine_mid
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_probe = tfr_doctrine_mid }
        tfr_probe_submarines_mastery = yes
        if = {
            limit = { check_variable = { tfr_doctrine_probe_pass = 1 } }
            set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_low = tfr_doctrine_mid }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_high = tfr_doctrine_mid } }
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = tfr_doctrine_high }
        subtract_from_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = tfr_doctrine_low }
    }
    set_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_submarines_whole = tfr_doctrine_low }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_probe = tfr_doctrine_low }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_low = 0 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_high = 10 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = 10 }
    while_loop_effect = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap > 1 } }
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = tfr_doctrine_low }
        add_to_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = tfr_doctrine_high }
        divide_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = 2 }
        round_variable = tfr_doctrine_mid
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_d1 = tfr_doctrine_mid }
        tfr_probe_submarines_mastery = yes
        if = {
            limit = { check_variable = { tfr_doctrine_probe_pass = 1 } }
            set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_low = tfr_doctrine_mid }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_high = tfr_doctrine_mid } }
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = tfr_doctrine_high }
        subtract_from_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = tfr_doctrine_low }
    }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_d1 = tfr_doctrine_low }
    set_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_submarines_d1 = tfr_doctrine_low }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_low = 0 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_high = 10 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = 10 }
    while_loop_effect = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap > 1 } }
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = tfr_doctrine_low }
        add_to_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = tfr_doctrine_high }
        divide_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = 2 }
        round_variable = tfr_doctrine_mid
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_d2 = tfr_doctrine_mid }
        tfr_probe_submarines_mastery = yes
        if = {
            limit = { check_variable = { tfr_doctrine_probe_pass = 1 } }
            set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_low = tfr_doctrine_mid }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_high = tfr_doctrine_mid } }
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = tfr_doctrine_high }
        subtract_from_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = tfr_doctrine_low }
    }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_d2 = tfr_doctrine_low }
    set_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_submarines_d2 = tfr_doctrine_low }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_low = 0 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_high = 10 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = 10 }
    while_loop_effect = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap > 1 } }
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = tfr_doctrine_low }
        add_to_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = tfr_doctrine_high }
        divide_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = 2 }
        round_variable = tfr_doctrine_mid
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_d3 = tfr_doctrine_mid }
        tfr_probe_submarines_mastery = yes
        if = {
            limit = { check_variable = { tfr_doctrine_probe_pass = 1 } }
            set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_low = tfr_doctrine_mid }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_high = tfr_doctrine_mid } }
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = tfr_doctrine_high }
        subtract_from_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = tfr_doctrine_low }
    }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_d3 = tfr_doctrine_low }
    set_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_submarines_d3 = tfr_doctrine_low }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_low = 0 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_high = 10 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = 10 }
    while_loop_effect = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap > 1 } }
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = tfr_doctrine_low }
        add_to_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = tfr_doctrine_high }
        divide_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = 2 }
        round_variable = tfr_doctrine_mid
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_d4 = tfr_doctrine_mid }
        tfr_probe_submarines_mastery = yes
        if = {
            limit = { check_variable = { tfr_doctrine_probe_pass = 1 } }
            set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_low = tfr_doctrine_mid }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_high = tfr_doctrine_mid } }
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = tfr_doctrine_high }
        subtract_from_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = tfr_doctrine_low }
    }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_d4 = tfr_doctrine_low }
    set_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_submarines_d4 = tfr_doctrine_low }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_low = 0 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_high = 10 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = 10 }
    while_loop_effect = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap > 1 } }
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = tfr_doctrine_low }
        add_to_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = tfr_doctrine_high }
        divide_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = 2 }
        round_variable = tfr_doctrine_mid
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_d5 = tfr_doctrine_mid }
        tfr_probe_submarines_mastery = yes
        if = {
            limit = { check_variable = { tfr_doctrine_probe_pass = 1 } }
            set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_low = tfr_doctrine_mid }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_high = tfr_doctrine_mid } }
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = tfr_doctrine_high }
        subtract_from_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = tfr_doctrine_low }
    }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_d5 = tfr_doctrine_low }
    set_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_submarines_d5 = tfr_doctrine_low }
}

tfr_restore_submarines_mastery = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                check_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_submarines_whole > 0 }
                check_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_submarines_d1 > 0 }
                check_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_submarines_d2 > 0 }
                check_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_submarines_d3 > 0 }
                check_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_submarines_d4 > 0 }
                check_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_submarines_d5 > 0 }
            }
        }
        meta_effect = {
            text = {
                add_mastery = { folder = naval track = submarines amount = [AMOUNT] }
            }
            AMOUNT = "[?tfr_saved_mastery_submarines_whole|.0].[?tfr_saved_mastery_submarines_d1|.0][?tfr_saved_mastery_submarines_d2|.0][?tfr_saved_mastery_submarines_d3|.0][?tfr_saved_mastery_submarines_d4|.0][?tfr_saved_mastery_submarines_d5|.0]"
        }
    }
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_mastery_submarines_whole
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_mastery_submarines_d1
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_mastery_submarines_d2
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_mastery_submarines_d3
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_mastery_submarines_d4
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_mastery_submarines_d5
}

tfr_probe_screens_mastery = {
    meta_effect = {
        text = {
            if = {
                limit = { has_mastery = { track = screens amount = [AMOUNT] } }
                set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_probe_pass = 1 }
            }
            else = { set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_probe_pass = 0 } }
        }
        AMOUNT = "[?tfr_doctrine_probe|.0].[?tfr_doctrine_d1|.0][?tfr_doctrine_d2|.0][?tfr_doctrine_d3|.0][?tfr_doctrine_d4|.0][?tfr_doctrine_d5|.0]"
    }
}

        subtract_from_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = tfr_doctrine_low }
    }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_d4 = tfr_doctrine_low }
    set_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_screens_d4 = tfr_doctrine_low }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_low = 0 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_high = 10 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = 10 }
    while_loop_effect = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap > 1 } }
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = tfr_doctrine_low }
        add_to_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = tfr_doctrine_high }
        divide_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = 2 }
        round_variable = tfr_doctrine_mid
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_d5 = tfr_doctrine_mid }
        tfr_probe_screens_mastery = yes
        if = {
            limit = { check_variable = { tfr_doctrine_probe_pass = 1 } }
            set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_low = tfr_doctrine_mid }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_high = tfr_doctrine_mid } }
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = tfr_doctrine_high }
        subtract_from_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = tfr_doctrine_low }
    }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_d5 = tfr_doctrine_low }
    set_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_screens_d5 = tfr_doctrine_low }
}

tfr_restore_screens_mastery = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                check_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_screens_whole > 0 }
                check_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_screens_d1 > 0 }
                check_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_screens_d2 > 0 }
                check_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_screens_d3 > 0 }
                check_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_screens_d4 > 0 }
                check_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_screens_d5 > 0 }
            }
        }
        meta_effect = {
            text = {
                add_mastery = { folder = naval track = screens amount = [AMOUNT] }
            }
            AMOUNT = "[?tfr_saved_mastery_screens_whole|.0].[?tfr_saved_mastery_screens_d1|.0][?tfr_saved_mastery_screens_d2|.0][?tfr_saved_mastery_screens_d3|.0][?tfr_saved_mastery_screens_d4|.0][?tfr_saved_mastery_screens_d5|.0]"
        }
    }
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_mastery_screens_whole
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_mastery_screens_d1
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_mastery_screens_d2
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_mastery_screens_d3
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_mastery_screens_d4
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_mastery_screens_d5
}

# Use integer variables only. Assemble decimal digits as text because script
# arithmetic has less precision and range than doctrine mastery.
tfr_probe_carriers_mastery = {
    meta_effect = {
        text = {
            if = {
                limit = { has_mastery = { track = carriers amount = [AMOUNT] } }
                set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_probe_pass = 1 }
            }
            else = { set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_probe_pass = 0 } }
        }
        AMOUNT = "[?tfr_doctrine_probe|.0].[?tfr_doctrine_d1|.0][?tfr_doctrine_d2|.0][?tfr_doctrine_d3|.0][?tfr_doctrine_d4|.0][?tfr_doctrine_d5|.0]"
    }
}

tfr_save_naval_doctrines = {
    set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_submarines = 0 }
    if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = wolfpacks }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_submarines = 1 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = submarine_fleet_operations }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_submarines = 2 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = capital_hunters }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_submarines = 3 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = submarine_coastal_defense }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_submarines = 4 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = coastal_minelaying }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_submarines = 5 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = long_range_submarines }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_submarines = 6 }
    }
    tfr_save_submarines_mastery = yes
    set_variable = { tfr_saved_counter_exists_submarines = 0 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = submarines_milestone_var }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_counter_exists_submarines = 1 }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_counter_submarines = submarines_milestone_var }
    }
    set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_screens = 0 }
    if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = convoy_escort }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_screens = 1 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = support_integrated_operations }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_screens = 2 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = hunter_killers }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_screens = 3 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = torpedo_primacy }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_screens = 4 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = anti_aircraft_cruisers }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_screens = 5 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = screen_support_focus }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_screens = 6 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = jeune_ecole }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_screens = 7 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = patrol_boats }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_screens = 8 }
    }
    tfr_save_screens_mastery = yes
    set_variable = { tfr_saved_counter_exists_screens = 0 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = screens_milestone_var }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_counter_exists_screens = 1 }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_counter_screens = screens_milestone_var }
    }
    set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_carriers = 0 }
    if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = carrier_battlegroups }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_carriers = 1 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = floating_airfields }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_carriers = 2 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = escort_carrier_support }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_carriers = 3 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = broad_naval_support }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_carriers = 4 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = massed_carrier_fleet }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_carriers = 5 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = light_task_forces }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_carriers = 6 }
    }
    tfr_save_carriers_mastery = yes
    set_variable = { tfr_saved_counter_exists_carriers = 0 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = carriers_milestone_var }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_counter_exists_carriers = 1 }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_counter_carriers = carriers_milestone_var }
    }
    set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_capital_ships = 0 }
    if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = line_of_battle }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_capital_ships = 1 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = battlecruiser_supremacy }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_capital_ships = 2 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = armored_raiders }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_capital_ships = 3 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = coastal_defence_fleet }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_capital_ships = 4 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = naval_gunfire_support }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_capital_ships = 5 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = battleship_antiair_screen }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_capital_ships = 6 }
    }
    tfr_save_capital_ships_mastery = yes
    set_variable = { tfr_saved_counter_exists_capital_ships = 0 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = capital_ships_milestone_var }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_counter_exists_capital_ships = 1 }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_counter_capital_ships = capital_ships_milestone_var }
    }
}

tfr_restore_naval_doctrines = {
    if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_submarines = 1 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = wolfpacks folder = naval track = 0 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_submarines = 2 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = submarine_fleet_operations folder = naval track = 0 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_submarines = 3 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = capital_hunters folder = naval track = 0 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_submarines = 4 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = submarine_coastal_defense folder = naval track = 0 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_submarines = 5 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = coastal_minelaying folder = naval track = 0 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_submarines = 6 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = long_range_submarines folder = naval track = 0 }
    }
    tfr_restore_submarines_mastery = yes
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_sub_submarines
    if = { limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_counter_exists_submarines = 1 } }
        set_variable = { submarines_milestone_var = tfr_saved_counter_submarines }
    }
    else = { clear_variable = submarines_milestone_var }
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_counter_submarines
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_counter_exists_submarines
    if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_screens = 1 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = convoy_escort folder = naval track = 1 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_screens = 2 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = support_integrated_operations folder = naval track = 1 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_screens = 3 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = hunter_killers folder = naval track = 1 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_screens = 4 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = torpedo_primacy folder = naval track = 1 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_screens = 5 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = anti_aircraft_cruisers folder = naval track = 1 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_screens = 6 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = screen_support_focus folder = naval track = 1 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_screens = 7 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = jeune_ecole folder = naval track = 1 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_screens = 8 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = patrol_boats folder = naval track = 1 }
    }
    tfr_restore_screens_mastery = yes
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_sub_screens
    if = { limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_counter_exists_screens = 1 } }
        set_variable = { screens_milestone_var = tfr_saved_counter_screens }
    }
    else = { clear_variable = screens_milestone_var }
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_counter_screens
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_counter_exists_screens
    if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_carriers = 1 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = carrier_battlegroups folder = naval track = 2 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_carriers = 2 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = floating_airfields folder = naval track = 2 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_carriers = 3 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = escort_carrier_support folder = naval track = 2 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_carriers = 4 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = broad_naval_support folder = naval track = 2 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_carriers = 5 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = massed_carrier_fleet folder = naval track = 2 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_carriers = 6 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = light_task_forces folder = naval track = 2 }
    }
    tfr_restore_carriers_mastery = yes
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_sub_carriers
    if = { limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_counter_exists_carriers = 1 } }
        set_variable = { carriers_milestone_var = tfr_saved_counter_carriers }
    }
    else = { clear_variable = carriers_milestone_var }
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_counter_carriers
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_counter_exists_carriers
    if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_capital_ships = 1 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = line_of_battle folder = naval track = 3 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_capital_ships = 2 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = battlecruiser_supremacy folder = naval track = 3 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_capital_ships = 3 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = armored_raiders folder = naval track = 3 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_capital_ships = 4 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = coastal_defence_fleet folder = naval track = 3 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_capital_ships = 5 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = naval_gunfire_support folder = naval track = 3 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_capital_ships = 6 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = battleship_antiair_screen folder = naval track = 3 }
    }
    tfr_restore_capital_ships_mastery = yes
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_sub_capital_ships
    if = { limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_counter_exists_capital_ships = 1 } }
        set_variable = { capital_ships_milestone_var = tfr_saved_counter_capital_ships }
    }
    else = { clear_variable = capital_ships_milestone_var }
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_counter_capital_ships
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_counter_exists_capital_ships
    tfr_clear_doctrine_snapshot = yes
}

# Use integer variables only. Assemble decimal digits as text because script
# arithmetic has less precision and range than doctrine mastery.
tfr_probe_fighter_aircraft_mastery = {
    meta_effect = {
        text = {
            if = {
                limit = { has_mastery = { track = fighter_aircraft amount = [AMOUNT] } }
                set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_probe_pass = 1 }
            }
            else = { set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_probe_pass = 0 } }
        }
        AMOUNT = "[?tfr_doctrine_probe|.0].[?tfr_doctrine_d1|.0][?tfr_doctrine_d2|.0][?tfr_doctrine_d3|.0][?tfr_doctrine_d4|.0][?tfr_doctrine_d5|.0]"
    }
}

tfr_save_fighter_aircraft_mastery = {
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_d1 = 0 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_d2 = 0 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_d3 = 0 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_d4 = 0 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_d5 = 0 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_low = 0 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_high = 1024 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_probe = 1024 }
    tfr_probe_fighter_aircraft_mastery = yes
    while_loop_effect = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_doctrine_probe_pass = 1 } }
        multiply_variable = { tfr_doctrine_high = 2 }
        multiply_variable = { tfr_doctrine_probe = 2 }
        tfr_probe_fighter_aircraft_mastery = yes
    }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = tfr_doctrine_high }
    while_loop_effect = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap > 1 } }
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = tfr_doctrine_low }
        add_to_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = tfr_doctrine_high }
        divide_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = 2 }
        round_variable = tfr_doctrine_mid
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_probe = tfr_doctrine_mid }
        tfr_probe_fighter_aircraft_mastery = yes
        if = {
            limit = { check_variable = { tfr_doctrine_probe_pass = 1 } }
            set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_low = tfr_doctrine_mid }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_high = tfr_doctrine_mid } }
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = tfr_doctrine_high }
        subtract_from_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = tfr_doctrine_low }
    }
    set_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_fighter_aircraft_whole = tfr_doctrine_low }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_probe = tfr_doctrine_low }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_low = 0 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_high = 10 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = 10 }
    while_loop_effect = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap > 1 } }
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = tfr_doctrine_low }
        add_to_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = tfr_doctrine_high }
        divide_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = 2 }
        round_variable = tfr_doctrine_mid
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_d1 = tfr_doctrine_mid }
        tfr_probe_fighter_aircraft_mastery = yes
        if = {
            limit = { check_variable = { tfr_doctrine_probe_pass = 1 } }
            set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_low = tfr_doctrine_mid }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_high = tfr_doctrine_mid } }
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = tfr_doctrine_high }
        subtract_from_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = tfr_doctrine_low }
    }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_d1 = tfr_doctrine_low }
    set_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_fighter_aircraft_d1 = tfr_doctrine_low }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_low = 0 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_high = 10 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = 10 }
    while_loop_effect = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap > 1 } }
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = tfr_doctrine_low }
        add_to_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = tfr_doctrine_high }
        divide_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = 2 }
        round_variable = tfr_doctrine_mid
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_d2 = tfr_doctrine_mid }
        tfr_probe_fighter_aircraft_mastery = yes
        if = {
            limit = { check_variable = { tfr_doctrine_probe_pass = 1 } }
            set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_low = tfr_doctrine_mid }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_high = tfr_doctrine_mid } }
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = tfr_doctrine_high }
        subtract_from_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = tfr_doctrine_low }
    }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_d2 = tfr_doctrine_low }
    set_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_fighter_aircraft_d2 = tfr_doctrine_low }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_low = 0 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_high = 10 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = 10 }
    while_loop_effect = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap > 1 } }
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = tfr_doctrine_low }
        add_to_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = tfr_doctrine_high }
        divide_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = 2 }
        round_variable = tfr_doctrine_mid
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_d3 = tfr_doctrine_mid }
        tfr_probe_fighter_aircraft_mastery = yes
        if = {
            limit = { check_variable = { tfr_doctrine_probe_pass = 1 } }
            set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_low = tfr_doctrine_mid }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_high = tfr_doctrine_mid } }
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = tfr_doctrine_high }
        subtract_from_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = tfr_doctrine_low }
    }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_d3 = tfr_doctrine_low }
    set_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_fighter_aircraft_d3 = tfr_doctrine_low }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_low = 0 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_high = 10 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = 10 }
    while_loop_effect = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap > 1 } }
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = tfr_doctrine_low }
        add_to_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = tfr_doctrine_high }
        divide_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = 2 }
        round_variable = tfr_doctrine_mid
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_d4 = tfr_doctrine_mid }
        tfr_probe_fighter_aircraft_mastery = yes
        if = {
            limit = { check_variable = { tfr_doctrine_probe_pass = 1 } }
            set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_low = tfr_doctrine_mid }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_high = tfr_doctrine_mid } }
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = tfr_doctrine_high }
        subtract_from_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = tfr_doctrine_low }
    }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_d4 = tfr_doctrine_low }
    set_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_fighter_aircraft_d4 = tfr_doctrine_low }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_low = 0 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_high = 10 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = 10 }
    while_loop_effect = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap > 1 } }
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = tfr_doctrine_low }
        add_to_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = tfr_doctrine_high }
        divide_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = 2 }
        round_variable = tfr_doctrine_mid
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_d5 = tfr_doctrine_mid }
        tfr_probe_fighter_aircraft_mastery = yes
        if = {
            limit = { check_variable = { tfr_doctrine_probe_pass = 1 } }
            set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_low = tfr_doctrine_mid }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_high = tfr_doctrine_mid } }
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = tfr_doctrine_high }
        subtract_from_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = tfr_doctrine_low }
    }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_d5 = tfr_doctrine_low }
    set_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_fighter_aircraft_d5 = tfr_doctrine_low }
}

tfr_restore_fighter_aircraft_mastery = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                check_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_fighter_aircraft_whole > 0 }
                check_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_fighter_aircraft_d1 > 0 }
                check_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_fighter_aircraft_d2 > 0 }
                check_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_fighter_aircraft_d3 > 0 }
                check_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_fighter_aircraft_d4 > 0 }
                check_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_fighter_aircraft_d5 > 0 }
            }
        }
        meta_effect = {
            text = {
                add_mastery = { folder = air track = fighter_aircraft amount = [AMOUNT] }
            }
            AMOUNT = "[?tfr_saved_mastery_fighter_aircraft_whole|.0].[?tfr_saved_mastery_fighter_aircraft_d1|.0][?tfr_saved_mastery_fighter_aircraft_d2|.0][?tfr_saved_mastery_fighter_aircraft_d3|.0][?tfr_saved_mastery_fighter_aircraft_d4|.0][?tfr_saved_mastery_fighter_aircraft_d5|.0]"
        }
    }
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_mastery_fighter_aircraft_whole
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_mastery_fighter_aircraft_d1
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_mastery_fighter_aircraft_d2
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_mastery_fighter_aircraft_d3
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_mastery_fighter_aircraft_d4
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_mastery_fighter_aircraft_d5
}

# Use integer variables only. Assemble decimal digits as text because script
# arithmetic has less precision and range than doctrine mastery.
tfr_probe_strike_aircraft_mastery = {

            if = {
                limit = { has_mastery = { track = strike_aircraft amount = [AMOUNT] } }

    }
}

tfr_save_strike_aircraft_mastery = {
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_d1 = 0 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_d2 = 0 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_d3 = 0 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_d4 = 0 }

        multiply_variable = { tfr_doctrine_high = 2 }
        multiply_variable = { tfr_doctrine_probe = 2 }
        tfr_probe_strike_aircraft_mastery = yes
    }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = tfr_doctrine_high }
    while_loop_effect = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap > 1 } }
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = tfr_doctrine_low }
        add_to_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = tfr_doctrine_high }
        divide_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = 2 }
        round_variable = tfr_doctrine_mid
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_probe = tfr_doctrine_mid }

        if = {
            limit = { check_variable = { tfr_doctrine_probe_pass = 1 } }
            set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_low = tfr_doctrine_mid }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_high = tfr_doctrine_mid } }
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = tfr_doctrine_high }
        subtract_from_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = tfr_doctrine_low }
    }
    set_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_strike_aircraft_whole = tfr_doctrine_low }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_probe = tfr_doctrine_low }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_low = 0 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_high = 10 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = 10 }
    while_loop_effect = {

tfr_restore_strike_aircraft_mastery = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                check_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_strike_aircraft_whole > 0 }
                check_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_strike_aircraft_d1 > 0 }
                check_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_strike_aircraft_d2 > 0 }
                check_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_strike_aircraft_d3 > 0 }
                check_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_strike_aircraft_d4 > 0 }
                check_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_strike_aircraft_d5 > 0 }
            }
        }
        meta_effect = {
            text = {
                add_mastery = { folder = air track = strike_aircraft amount = [AMOUNT] }
            }
            AMOUNT = "[?tfr_saved_mastery_strike_aircraft_whole|.0].[?tfr_saved_mastery_strike_aircraft_d1|.0][?tfr_saved_mastery_strike_aircraft_d2|.0][?tfr_saved_mastery_strike_aircraft_d3|.0][?tfr_saved_mastery_strike_aircraft_d4|.0][?tfr_saved_mastery_strike_aircraft_d5|.0]"
        }
    }
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_mastery_strike_aircraft_whole
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_mastery_strike_aircraft_d1
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_mastery_strike_aircraft_d2
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_mastery_strike_aircraft_d3
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_mastery_strike_aircraft_d4
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_mastery_strike_aircraft_d5
}

# Use integer variables only. Assemble decimal digits as text because script
# arithmetic has less precision and range than doctrine mastery.
tfr_probe_medium_aircraft_mastery = {
    meta_effect = {
        text = {
            if = {
                limit = { has_mastery = { track = medium_aircraft amount = [AMOUNT] } }
                set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_probe_pass = 1 }
            }
            else = { set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_probe_pass = 0 } }
        }
        AMOUNT = "[?tfr_doctrine_probe|.0].[?tfr_doctrine_d1|.0][?tfr_doctrine_d2|.0][?tfr_doctrine_d3|.0][?tfr_doctrine_d4|.0][?tfr_doctrine_d5|.0]"
    }
}

tfr_save_medium_aircraft_mastery = {
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_d1 = 0 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_d2 = 0 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_d3 = 0 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_d4 = 0 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_d5 = 0 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_low = 0 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_high = 1024 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_probe = 1024 }
    tfr_probe_medium_aircraft_mastery = yes
    while_loop_effect = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_doctrine_probe_pass = 1 } }
        multiply_variable = { tfr_doctrine_high = 2 }
        multiply_variable = { tfr_doctrine_probe = 2 }
        tfr_probe_medium_aircraft_mastery = yes
    }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = tfr_doctrine_high }
    while_loop_effect = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap > 1 } }
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = tfr_doctrine_low }
        add_to_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = tfr_doctrine_high }
        divide_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = 2 }
        round_variable = tfr_doctrine_mid
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_probe = tfr_doctrine_mid }
        tfr_probe_medium_aircraft_mastery = yes
        if = {
            limit = { check_variable = { tfr_doctrine_probe_pass = 1 } }
            set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_low = tfr_doctrine_mid }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_high = tfr_doctrine_mid } }
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = tfr_doctrine_high }
        subtract_from_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = tfr_doctrine_low }
    }
    set_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_medium_aircraft_whole = tfr_doctrine_low }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_probe = tfr_doctrine_low }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_low = 0 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_high = 10 }

        }
