        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap > 1 } }
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = tfr_doctrine_low }
        add_to_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = tfr_doctrine_high }
        divide_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = 2 }
        round_variable = tfr_doctrine_mid
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_d4 = tfr_doctrine_mid }
        tfr_probe_heavy_aircraft_mastery = yes
        if = {
            limit = { check_variable = { tfr_doctrine_probe_pass = 1 } }
            set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_low = tfr_doctrine_mid }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_high = tfr_doctrine_mid } }
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = tfr_doctrine_high }
        subtract_from_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = tfr_doctrine_low }
    }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_d4 = tfr_doctrine_low }
    set_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_heavy_aircraft_d4 = tfr_doctrine_low }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_low = 0 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_high = 10 }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = 10 }
    while_loop_effect = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap > 1 } }
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = tfr_doctrine_low }
        add_to_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = tfr_doctrine_high }
        divide_variable = { tfr_doctrine_mid = 2 }
        round_variable = tfr_doctrine_mid
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_d5 = tfr_doctrine_mid }
        tfr_probe_heavy_aircraft_mastery = yes
        if = {
            limit = { check_variable = { tfr_doctrine_probe_pass = 1 } }
            set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_low = tfr_doctrine_mid }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_high = tfr_doctrine_mid } }
        set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = tfr_doctrine_high }
        subtract_from_variable = { tfr_doctrine_gap = tfr_doctrine_low }
    }
    set_variable = { tfr_doctrine_d5 = tfr_doctrine_low }
    set_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_heavy_aircraft_d5 = tfr_doctrine_low }
}

tfr_restore_heavy_aircraft_mastery = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                check_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_heavy_aircraft_whole > 0 }
                check_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_heavy_aircraft_d1 > 0 }
                check_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_heavy_aircraft_d2 > 0 }
                check_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_heavy_aircraft_d3 > 0 }
                check_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_heavy_aircraft_d4 > 0 }
                check_variable = { tfr_saved_mastery_heavy_aircraft_d5 > 0 }
            }
        }
        meta_effect = {
            text = {
                add_mastery = { folder = air track = heavy_aircraft amount = [AMOUNT] }
            }
            AMOUNT = "[?tfr_saved_mastery_heavy_aircraft_whole|.0].[?tfr_saved_mastery_heavy_aircraft_d1|.0][?tfr_saved_mastery_heavy_aircraft_d2|.0][?tfr_saved_mastery_heavy_aircraft_d3|.0][?tfr_saved_mastery_heavy_aircraft_d4|.0][?tfr_saved_mastery_heavy_aircraft_d5|.0]"
        }
    }
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_mastery_heavy_aircraft_whole
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_mastery_heavy_aircraft_d1
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_mastery_heavy_aircraft_d2
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_mastery_heavy_aircraft_d3
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_mastery_heavy_aircraft_d4
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_mastery_heavy_aircraft_d5
}

tfr_save_air_doctrines = {
    set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_fighter_aircraft = 0 }
    if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = air_subdoctrine_fighter_homeland_defense }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_fighter_aircraft = 1 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = air_subdoctrine_escort_fighter }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_fighter_aircraft = 2 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = air_subdoctrine_fighter_bombers }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_fighter_aircraft = 3 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = air_subdoctrine_tactical_flexibility }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_fighter_aircraft = 4 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = air_subdoctrine_dogfighting_mastery }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_fighter_aircraft = 5 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = air_subdoctrine_fighter_central_field }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_fighter_aircraft = 6 }
    }
    tfr_save_fighter_aircraft_mastery = yes
    set_variable = { tfr_saved_counter_exists_fighter_aircraft = 0 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = fighters_milestone_var }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_counter_exists_fighter_aircraft = 1 }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_counter_fighter_aircraft = fighters_milestone_var }
    }
    set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_strike_aircraft = 0 }
    if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = air_subdoctrine_flying_artillery }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_strike_aircraft = 1 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = air_subdoctrine_dive_bombers }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_strike_aircraft = 2 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = air_subdoctrine_flexible_fire_support }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_strike_aircraft = 3 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = air_subdoctrine_carrier_strikes }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_strike_aircraft = 4 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = air_subdoctrine_naval_strike_tactics }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_strike_aircraft = 5 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = air_subdoctrine_naval_torpedo_tactics }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_strike_aircraft = 6 }
    }
    tfr_save_strike_aircraft_mastery = yes
    set_variable = { tfr_saved_counter_exists_strike_aircraft = 0 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = strikers_milestone_var }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_counter_exists_strike_aircraft = 1 }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_counter_strike_aircraft = strikers_milestone_var }
    }
    set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_medium_aircraft = 0 }
    if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = air_subdoctrine_bomber_interception }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_medium_aircraft = 1 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = air_subdoctrine_long_range_escort }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_medium_aircraft = 2 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = air_subdoctrine_operational_air_support }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_medium_aircraft = 3 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = air_subdoctrine_tactical_battlefield_support }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_medium_aircraft = 4 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = air_subdoctrine_theater_interdiction }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_medium_aircraft = 5 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = air_subdoctrine_aerial_reconnaissance }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_medium_aircraft = 6 }
    }
    tfr_save_medium_aircraft_mastery = yes
    set_variable = { tfr_saved_counter_exists_medium_aircraft = 0 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = mediums_milestone_var }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_counter_exists_medium_aircraft = 1 }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_counter_medium_aircraft = mediums_milestone_var }
    }
    set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_heavy_aircraft = 0 }
    if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = air_subdoctrine_night_bombing }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_heavy_aircraft = 1 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = air_subdoctrine_carpet_bombing }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_heavy_aircraft = 2 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = air_subdoctrine_deep_air_raids }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_heavy_aircraft = 3 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = air_subdoctrine_flying_fortresses }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_heavy_aircraft = 4 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = air_subdoctrine_coastal_air_patrol }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_heavy_aircraft = 5 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = air_subdoctrine_open_ocean_air_patrol }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_heavy_aircraft = 6 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_doctrine = air_subdoctrine_heavy_aircraft_focus }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_heavy_aircraft = 7 }
    }
    tfr_save_heavy_aircraft_mastery = yes
    set_variable = { tfr_saved_counter_exists_heavy_aircraft = 0 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = heavies_milestone_var }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_counter_exists_heavy_aircraft = 1 }
        set_variable = { tfr_saved_counter_heavy_aircraft = heavies_milestone_var }
    }
}

tfr_restore_air_doctrines = {
    if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_fighter_aircraft = 1 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = air_subdoctrine_fighter_homeland_defense folder = air track = 0 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_fighter_aircraft = 2 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = air_subdoctrine_escort_fighter folder = air track = 0 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_fighter_aircraft = 3 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = air_subdoctrine_fighter_bombers folder = air track = 0 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_fighter_aircraft = 4 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = air_subdoctrine_tactical_flexibility folder = air track = 0 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_fighter_aircraft = 5 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = air_subdoctrine_dogfighting_mastery folder = air track = 0 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_fighter_aircraft = 6 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = air_subdoctrine_fighter_central_field folder = air track = 0 }
    }
    tfr_restore_fighter_aircraft_mastery = yes
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_sub_fighter_aircraft
    if = { limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_counter_exists_fighter_aircraft = 1 } }
        set_variable = { fighters_milestone_var = tfr_saved_counter_fighter_aircraft }
    }
    else = { clear_variable = fighters_milestone_var }
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_counter_fighter_aircraft
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_counter_exists_fighter_aircraft
    if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_strike_aircraft = 1 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = air_subdoctrine_flying_artillery folder = air track = 1 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_strike_aircraft = 2 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = air_subdoctrine_dive_bombers folder = air track = 1 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_strike_aircraft = 3 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = air_subdoctrine_flexible_fire_support folder = air track = 1 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_strike_aircraft = 4 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = air_subdoctrine_carrier_strikes folder = air track = 1 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_strike_aircraft = 5 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = air_subdoctrine_naval_strike_tactics folder = air track = 1 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_strike_aircraft = 6 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = air_subdoctrine_naval_torpedo_tactics folder = air track = 1 }
    }
    tfr_restore_strike_aircraft_mastery = yes
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_sub_strike_aircraft
    if = { limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_counter_exists_strike_aircraft = 1 } }
        set_variable = { strikers_milestone_var = tfr_saved_counter_strike_aircraft }
    }
    else = { clear_variable = strikers_milestone_var }
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_counter_strike_aircraft
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_counter_exists_strike_aircraft
    if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_medium_aircraft = 1 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = air_subdoctrine_bomber_interception folder = air track = 2 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_medium_aircraft = 2 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = air_subdoctrine_long_range_escort folder = air track = 2 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_medium_aircraft = 3 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = air_subdoctrine_operational_air_support folder = air track = 2 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_medium_aircraft = 4 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = air_subdoctrine_tactical_battlefield_support folder = air track = 2 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_medium_aircraft = 5 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = air_subdoctrine_theater_interdiction folder = air track = 2 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_medium_aircraft = 6 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = air_subdoctrine_aerial_reconnaissance folder = air track = 2 }
    }
    tfr_restore_medium_aircraft_mastery = yes
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_sub_medium_aircraft
    if = { limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_counter_exists_medium_aircraft = 1 } }
        set_variable = { mediums_milestone_var = tfr_saved_counter_medium_aircraft }
    }
    else = { clear_variable = mediums_milestone_var }
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_counter_medium_aircraft
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_counter_exists_medium_aircraft
    if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_heavy_aircraft = 1 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = air_subdoctrine_night_bombing folder = air track = 3 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_heavy_aircraft = 2 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = air_subdoctrine_carpet_bombing folder = air track = 3 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_heavy_aircraft = 3 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = air_subdoctrine_deep_air_raids folder = air track = 3 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_heavy_aircraft = 4 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = air_subdoctrine_flying_fortresses folder = air track = 3 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_heavy_aircraft = 5 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = air_subdoctrine_coastal_air_patrol folder = air track = 3 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_heavy_aircraft = 6 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = air_subdoctrine_open_ocean_air_patrol folder = air track = 3 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_sub_heavy_aircraft = 7 } }
        set_sub_doctrine = { sub_doctrine = air_subdoctrine_heavy_aircraft_focus folder = air track = 3 }
    }
    tfr_restore_heavy_aircraft_mastery = yes
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_sub_heavy_aircraft
    if = { limit = { check_variable = { tfr_saved_counter_exists_heavy_aircraft = 1 } }
        set_variable = { heavies_milestone_var = tfr_saved_counter_heavy_aircraft }
    }
    else = { clear_variable = heavies_milestone_var }
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_counter_heavy_aircraft
    clear_variable = tfr_saved_counter_exists_heavy_aircraft
    tfr_clear_doctrine_snapshot = yes
}
